fedele:
FAITHFUL PHOTO MODE (NO FANTASY THEME): Translate ONLY the real subject(s), their real pose, their real clothing and worn accessories, and the essential real-world setting from the attached photo into a clean, joyful coloring page.
- Smart background cleanup: If the photo was taken indoors against messy household clutter, shelves, cables, retail boxes, scattered floor toys, or a plain studio surface, replace the distracting clutter with clean open white space, a simple grounding surface line, and only the 1-2 real foreground objects the subject is directly touching or holding. If the photo shows a meaningful outdoor or travel setting (beach, garden, park, mountain, street, landmark), keep that real place recognizable using simplified, bold, uncluttered shapes in crisp solid black lines (never faint grey) that stay visually subordinate and never overpower the main subject.
- Child-friendly clarity: Use bold, smooth outer contours and clean medium inner lines with generous medium-to-large closed coloring areas (simplify dense foliage, knit/yarn strands, tiny polka dots, LEGO stud grids, and complex patterns into clear colorable shapes).
- Strict fidelity guard: DO NOT invent or add any fantasy theme, pirates, ships, unicorns, dragons, knights, space rockets, aliens, dinosaurs, castles, crowns, costume changes, newly invented hats, or imaginary creatures/props not present in the photo.
creativa:
CREATIVE FANTASY MODE: Isolate ONLY the main foreground hero subject(s) from the photo (leaving behind indoor room clutter, shelves, playmats, scattered extra floor toys, and unrelated original background objects) and place them naturally as the grounded foreground hero (55-75% of page height) inside the new themed world.
- Head, face & real accessories protection: Faces, hair, and animal/toy heads must remain completely clear and unobstructed. Preserve any real glasses, baseball caps, hats, bows, or headbands already worn in the original photo, while NEVER adding newly invented helmets, hats, masks, crowns, tiaras, or overlapping props onto anyone's head or face.
- Subject-aware staging: If people appear in the photo, adapt only their body outfit below the neck into a simple, comfortable themed costume while keeping their real head, hair, worn cap/glasses, pose, and any held object recognizable. If animals, pets, plushies, dolls, or toy vehicles are the subject (with no people in the photo), keep their exact physical form intact—do NOT dress animals or toys in human clothes and do NOT invent imaginary human characters—and stage them naturally as the hero interacting with the themed world (for example, an aquatic pet can swim in a themed pond or sea). If a landscape is the subject, weave the themed elements harmoniously into the real scenery.
- Open varied composition: Use a natural, asymmetric storybook layout with open breathing space in the sky and ground—avoid repetitive symmetrical corner leaf frames or boxed-in backdrops.
